All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AnimationUtil
Collection of static helper methods that apply JavaFX animations (and, in a few cases, paired sound effects) to UI nodes: card transitions, button hover/press feedback, turn highlighting, and elimination/error feedback.
Card
Represents a single playing card, defined by its Rank (2-10, J, Q, K, A) and Suit (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades).
Deck
Represents the draw deck used during a match: a standard 52-card deck (one Card per combination of Rank and Suit), implemented as a Stack so that drawing always removes the card on top.
DialogUtil
Provides simple, custom-styled modal dialogs used throughout the application, since the project favors a fully custom look over the default JavaFX Alert styling.
DrawCardThread
Background thread that draws a replacement card for a player after they play one, without blocking the JavaFX application thread.
EmptyDeckException
Thrown when a card is requested from a deck that has no cards left to draw.
EndController
Controller for the results screen (EndView.fxml), shown once a match ends.
EndStage
 
GameConstants
Centralizes the configuration constants used throughout the game, so that game-balance values are not scattered as magic numbers across the codebase.
GameController
Controller for the main game screen (GameView.fxml).
GameModel
Orchestrates a single Cincuentazo match: holds the list of players, the deck, the table pile, and the turn order, and exposes the operations needed to drive the game loop (advancing turns, eliminating players, detecting the winner).
GameStage
 
GameStateException
Thrown when an operation is attempted that is not valid for the current state of the match, such as advancing the turn after the game has already ended.
HomeController
Controller for the home/main menu screen (HomeView.fxml).
HomeStage
 
HumanPlayer
Represents the player controlled by the person in front of the computer.
ICardClickHandler
 
IDeckOperations
 
IEliminable
 
InvalidCardPlayException
Thrown when a player attempts to play a card that would cause the table sum to exceed the maximum allowed value.
IPlayable
 
MachinePlayer
Player controlled by the computer (AI).
MachinePlayerThread
Background thread that resolves a single AI player's turn without blocking the JavaFX application thread.
Main
Main class of the Cincuentazo card game application.
MusicManager
Manages background music and short sound effects using javax.sound.sampled.
Player
Abstract base class representing a player in a Cincuentazo match.
PlayerType
Identifies whether a Player is controlled by a human or by the computer.
Rank
The thirteen ranks of a standard deck of playing cards, each carrying its base point value in Cincuentazo and the base path to its front-face image resource.
Suit
The four suits of a standard deck of playing cards.
TablePile
Represents the central discard pile on the table, where every played card is stacked and whose values accumulate into a running total (getCurrentSum()).
